name: Sanguis et Gloria: Shadow of the Labyrinth
storyline: After years of relentless searching, Spartan warrior Nikandros has finally uncovered the entrance to the fabled Labyrinth beneath Crete - the dark domain of the legendary Minotaur. Haunted by the memory of his brother’s death at the beast’s hands, Nikandros ventures deep into the twisting halls driven by vengeance and honor. Within the shifting shadows and ancient traps, he must face not only the monstrous ruler of the labyrinth but also the weight of his own rage. His goal is clear: to slay the Minotaur, claim its head as a trophy, and end the curse that has tormented his family for generations. Yet in the heart of the labyrinth, vengeance and destiny intertwine - and only one will escape its depths.
summary: Step into the depths of Crete and face the legendary Minotaur in this action-packed indie adventure. Play as Nikandros, a Spartan warrior forged in battle, as you fight against the might of the ruler of the labyrinths, the great Minotaur.
